annotations.title: Check a quote, invoice or ad against a license

description: Check whether a contractor's quote, invoice, contract, business card, ad or truck photo matches a California license in this dataset. Send the document as text, as a PNG or JPEG image (base64), or both, plus the license number to check against (if the text shows a license number from the dataset, it is used). Returns a verdict (consistent, number_only, mismatch or unclear; number_only means only the license number matched, which anyone could copy), whether the business name and license number on the document match the record, whether the work described falls outside the license's classifications, whether the down payment asked for is over California's limit ($1,000 or 10% of the price, whichever is less), and the license's status, bond and workers' comp checks. The verdict is a reading of the document, not proof. The document is read by TypeSafe's Jev model and is not stored by Swapwire; remove a homeowner's personal details before sending if you can.

image_base64.description: A photo or scan of the document, base64-encoded PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB.

image_format.description: Format of image_base64, if it can't be detected.

license_number.description: CSLB license number to check against, digits only. Optional if the text shows it.

text.description: The document's text, e.g. a pasted quote or ad. Up to 20,000 characters.

name: check_document

outputSchema.description: A reading of the document against one license.

data_as_of.description: Date the data was copied from the agency, YYYY-MM-DD.

down_payment.description: The down payment the text asks for, read by rule: asked_usd, asked_percent, contract_price_usd, limit_usd, over_limit (over California's $1,000 or 10% limit), detail, guide_url.

verdict.description: consistent, number_only, mismatch or unclear; or needs_license_number or license_not_in_dataset, with a note saying what to do.

title: Check a quote, invoice or ad against a license
